completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: 15-coin final release audit and promotion
active_mission.objective: Finish the 15-market Hixton release candidate for practical use while preserving the proven ten-coin Core. Keep the modular two-slot 50/50 allocator, activate only validated NEAR/BCH idle-gap Satellites, keep SUI/UNI/AAVE research-only, prove point-in-time/no-lookahead behavior and Backtest/Paper/Live/UI parity, and allow promotion to gpt/usdc-audit only after same-head A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS. Do not arm Live entries or send orders.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: Owner requested the best currently supported bot to be completed for future use. Research selected Core 2x50% plus NEAR/BCH idle fillers; final task is exact-head product integration, QA, governance and code promotion without live activation.
constraints: The proven ten Core profiles remain the primary strategy and must not regress.
Only NEARUSDC and BCHUSDC are active shared Satellites; SUIUSDC, UNIUSDC and AAVEUSDC remain research-only and must not allocate capital.
Satellites may enter only while the Core is completely idle and must yield required capital to executable Core entries at the next executable open.
Configured max capital X derives exactly two equal 50-percent slots. 250/125 and 1000/500 are examples, not fixed product sizing.
All trading decisions must be point-in-time from closed bars plus the next executable open. Future bars, holdout outcomes and validation results cannot steer runtime decisions.
The primary backtest window remains exactly three years with warmup; optimization/training may propose candidates, validation may reject but cannot retroactively invent winners.
Trade count is secondary to robust net profit, drawdown, costs, occupancy and out-of-sample behavior.
Backtest, Paper, Live and UI must describe the same 15-market roles and routing semantics.
Promotion is allowed only after fresh same-head A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS.
Promotion means code/product readiness only. Live entries remain disabled; no credentials are changed and no real/testnet orders are sent.
acceptance: A01 verifies requirements, no-lookahead methodology, active-vs-research Satellite roles and causal experiment history are non-contradictory.
A02 reproduces the exact three-year baseline/stress evidence, confirms 2x50% remains the selected shared layout, and verifies 250/1000 modular scaling.
A03 proves Backtest/Paper/Live parity for Core-first idle-only routing, NEAR/BCH entry filters/horizon behavior, capital sizing and next-open preemption.
A04 verifies UI source/browser/shipped bundle shows all 15 markets and correctly labels Core, active Satellites and research-only Satellites.
A05 verifies freshness/liveness/occupancy behavior and no stale market assumptions.
A06 runs full integration/regression checks and proves the ten-Core incumbent behavior is preserved under the selected routing layer.
A07 verifies current public Binance USDC execution rules and minimums for all active targets under modular capital sizing.
A08 verifies strategy/risk invariants, point-in-time semantics, drawdown/concentration and rejects any trade-count-only improvement.
A10 synthesizes all specialist evidence and routes every blocker to a named repair owner.
A09 emits QA_PASS only on one exact candidate commit after fresh Python/UI/browser/integration evidence passes.
A11 emits GOVERNANCE_PASS only after fresh QA_PASS and complete exact-head A01-A10 evidence.
After same-head QA_PASS and GOVERNANCE_PASS the candidate may be promoted to gpt/usdc-audit, but Live remains disabled.
